clockworks/tiktok-scraper.collects: TikTok videos by search, hashtag or profile; minimum charge cap USD 0.50

trudax/reddit-scraper-lite.collects: Reddit posts and comments; at least 10 items

junglee/Amazon-crawler.collects: Amazon.eg products: price, stock, rating, reviews, 'bought in past month', best-seller ranks. Don't set countryCode (adds USD 0.06 a product)

blackfalcondata/carrefour-maf-scraper.collects: Carrefour Egypt (market mafegy) prices, offers, stock. query is a string; one search per run
blackfalcondata/carrefour-maf-scraper.price: USD 0.01 a run + USD 0.002 a product

crawlerbros/noon-scraper.collects: Noon Egypt prices (market egypt, mode search, one searchQuery per run)
crawlerbros/noon-scraper.price: USD 0.005 a run + USD 0.005 an item

memo23/talabat-scraper.collects: Talabat restaurants and full menus. Use branchIds for exact restaurants; area listing pagination is unreliable, so page area lists through talabat.com and pass the IDs

apify/google-trends-scraper.collects: Google Trends interest over time and by governorate for a term (slow; low-volume terms can time out)
